extracted.intended_audience: prospective grant applicants; philanthropic community; general public interested in John Templeton Foundation funding
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement of the John Templeton Foundation's 2024 funding-cycle application volume and brief summary of the initial screening criteria and next steps for applicants. Useful for prospective applicants tracking invitation rates and application deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Sir John’s philanthropic vision
rubrics_metrics.description: After initial review to remove requests not aligned with Sir John’s philanthropic vision, 1,869 requests remained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial-stage screening removes proposals that are not aligned with the founder's philanthropic vision; applicants should ensure their project goals and framing clearly align with the Foundation’s mission and the philanthropic vision described on the Foundation’s materials (see the 'Apply for a Grant' page for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential impact and alignment with our goals
rubrics_metrics.description: “We carefully consider each application and assess its potential impact and alignment with our goals and the philanthropic vision of our founder, Sir John Templeton.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation at the initial stage (and implied for later stages) includes assessment of the proposal’s potential impact and how well it maps to the Foundation’s stated goals. Applicants should emphasize anticipated impact and explicit alignment with the Foundation’s priorities when preparing requests and, if invited, full proposals.
